Scenarios.Text: You are Pelle, a 28 years old student living in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text:
It's a friday afternoon and you are walking in the street, headed to meet a friend.
You pass a coffee-stand and the light is soft on the dry pavement.
In the distance you see two airplanes, while at the same time there's a slight tremble in the ground. 
What's your next action?

Choices.ButtonText: You stop at coffee-stand to buy an espresso
Choices.SummaryText: You choose to stop at the coffe-stand.

Choices.ButtonText: You take a seat on a bench
Choices.SummaryText: You sat on the bench, trying to find some news.

Choices.ButtonText: You decide to stop and listen to a street musician
Choices.SummaryText: You decided to listen to the street musician.

Scenarios.Text:
The barista tells you with an embarrased look that the cardreader have been malfunctioning a lot today. 
When you eventually get your coffee, you hear a sparkle from the carts radio. 'The government encourages...' before the sound is cut off

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text:
You sit down on the bench, pulling out your phone. 
You immediately try to get your newsapps working but they are buffering constantly. You look up with irritation and see that all the advertisement signs have stopped working.

Choices.ButtonText: The electricity dissapears in all the surrounding buildings.

Scenarios.Text: The musician plays a calm melody on his on his guitar, but stops abruptly as his speaker stops working.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text:
The atmosphere on the streets shifts suddenly and an eerie silence covers the area as a blanket. 
Choose your next action to the sudden shift:

Choices.ButtonText: You stand still and try to call your close ones in in panic even though the mobile network is down
Choices.SummaryText: You tried to call your close ones.

Choices.ButtonText: You run out to the town square so that you're able to get a clear view of the sky
Choices.SummaryText: You tried to get a clear view of the sky.

Choices.ButtonText: You feel exposed in the street and move to the entrance to a closed store in order to get your bearings
Choices.SummaryText: You searched shelter at the entrance of a closed store.

Scenarios.Text:
The air raid siren suddenly sets off and you can see bomber planes closing in on the city 
What's your next action?'

Choices.ButtonText: You follow your instincts and run with a larger mass of crowd towards the school area where you know there's a safety bunker for civilians.
You hurry to the closest open staircase in search from shelter to the sudden chaos.
You sneak into a dark alley in order to avoid crowds of people

Scenarios.Text:
You choose to follow your instincts and follow the herd. They moving in a frenzied pace, panic in the air. 
A shadow appears on the sky and a bomber plane approaches. It fires off a missile towards the crowd, and you hear your final thoughts rush in your head before the world explodes around you.

Choices.ButtonText: You died
Choices.SummaryText: You choose to follow the herd. A critical mistake as it was a prime target for an enemy plane. You died.

Scenarios.Text: The open staircase provides temporary shelter but you have to keep going. What's your choice?

Choices.ButtonText: Go down the stairs and access the cellar
Choices.SummaryText: You chose to seek shelter in a staircase, moving downwards to the cellar.

Choices.ButtonText: You run up the stairs to the second level
Choices.SummaryText: You chose to seek shelter in a staircase, moving upwards to the second level.

Scenarios.Text: The cellar is cloaked in darkness but you continue through it. A smell of gas creeps upon you

Choices.ButtonText: You ignore the smell and start to run through the darkness
You hold your breath and feel your way along the walls
Choices.SummaryText: You tried to hold your breath from the mysterious gas.

Scenarios.Text: The darkness reveals nothing and the gas starts to cloud your judgement. Sleepiness descends upon you while hallucinations starts to appear in front of you

Choices.ButtonText: You cave to the sleepiness, suddenly the floor seems fairly comfortable. You lay down.
Choices.SummaryText: You fell asleep in the dark cellar, choking to death.

Choices.ButtonText: A bright pink elephant wants to show you the exit. Follow it
Choices.SummaryText: You choose poorly, the pink elephant couldn't help you'.

Scenarios.Text: You lay down on the floor, the gas making you sleepy. You contemplate your last thoughts as your last sleep begins.

Choices.ButtonText: You died.

Scenarios.Text: The elephant seems to know what he's doing so you choose to follow him. Unfortunately he knows nothing and makes you go in loops in the cellar. The gas slowly makes you unconscious and you fall on the floor, authorities finding your body months later.

Choices.ButtonText: You died.

Scenarios.Text:
You identify that the gas might be dangerous and you try to hold your breath as much as you can. You traverse slowly through the pathway, a streak of orange-red light appearing at a distance. 
You move closer and find the a door which you are able to open, bringing you outside. It's quickly apparent from where the orange-red colour came from, the buildings around you are burning.

Choices.ButtonText: You stop and take in the scene, finding it hauntingly beautiful.
Continue towards the school area.

Scenarios.Text: As you watch the fires raging chaos among the buildings, you hear a sound above your head. You look up, seeing that the building you were inside is also on fire. A large chunk of bricks have collapsed and struck the top of your head, instantly killing you.

Choices.ButtonText: You died

Scenarios.Text: You choose not to linger, trying to find a safe path between the burning buildings. You carefully avoid narrow pathways and falling debris, moving closer to the school area.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text:
You reach the school area but you fall in despair as you see the area crowded, people scattered as to not be targets for bombers. 
While you wait for your turn, a voice on the area speakers says 'The safety bunker is now full. We cannot grant more people access to it' 
You groan loudly in frustration and panic, as does other people. You hear a couple talk about a safe haven at the harbors and you decide to hurry towards the next area.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text: You run up the stairs to the second level. All the doors are locked to the apartments but through the window you see a rusty fire escape ladder and a nearby metal roof slightly lower down.

Choices.ButtonText: You try your luck with the rusty fire escape ladder
You try your luck with jumping over to the metal roof

Scenarios.Text:
You move out the window, grabbing the rusty ladder tightly. You slowly start to descend on its steps. 
You make it halfways down when the ladder starts to creak and slowly starts to bend. You see a container below you filled with clutter but the fall is quite high.

Choices.ButtonText: You try your luck with the container, letting go off the ladder
You decide to try to climb down the last steps, the ladder should hold

Scenarios.Text: You fall down into the container, getting slightly bruised from the clutter but relatively unharmed. With a deep sigh, you muster strength and climb out of the container and make your way out to the courtyard.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text: You see movement between the alleyways, and you head out to see a group of people moving to the school area. You follow them at a close distance.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text:
You grip the ladder even tighter, your knuckles turning white from the stress. You try to descend once more, slowly making progress. After three steps, the ladder breaks from the top. 
You fall to the ground, barely registering the events before the heavy ladder falls on you, killing you instantly.

Choices.ButtonText: You died

Scenarios.Text: You climb out of the window, trying to measure the distance to the metal roof below you. You take a deep breath and jump off the ledge

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text: The air rushes through your face as you aim for the nearby roof. The jump fails as you barely make the distance, your arms reaching for something to hold, flailing wildly before you lose your balance and fall backwards. The air once again rushes through your head before you land face down on the hard concrete, dying instantly.

Choices.ButtonText: You died

Scenarios.Text:
The alleyway is dark and slightly scary but it's void of people. It's riddled with clutter, making progress through it risky. 
The sound from the street behind you is growing more chaotic.

Choices.ButtonText: You decide to risk walking through the clutter.

Scenarios.Text:
You try to make your way through the alleywall, the clutter making it a slow and tedious task. 
A bomb explodes a block away, making the clutter shift, pinning your foot beneath it. Panic starts to rise in your body.

Choices.ButtonText: You summon your strength and try to brute-force your leg free.
You try calm yourself before attempting to slowly free your leg. .

Scenarios.Text:
You succeed in breaking free, but you cut yourself on a sharp object, creating a large wound on your right leg. 
You make it through the worst part of the clutter, finding some space to rest. Your leg is bleeding heavily

Choices.ButtonText: You sit down on the ground, trying to create a temporary bandaid for your leg with your jacket.
You rest for a few seconds, but time is short. You decide to continue forwards.

Scenarios.Text: Your temporary band-aid stops the bleeding for the moment. You take a deep breath and try to continue forwards. The alleywall ends in an open area, giving you vision of the school and it's underground safe bunker. You move towards it'

Choices.ButtonText: Continue.

Scenarios.Text:
You reach the school area but you fall in despair as you see the area crowded, people scattered as to not be targets for bombers. 
Your leg hurts badly while you wait for your turn, a voice on the area speakers says 'The safety bunker is now full. We cannot grant more people access to it' 
You groan loudly in frustration and panic, as does other people. You hear a couple talk about a safe haven at the harbors and you decide to hurry towards the next area, as fast as your hurt leg allows you.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue

Scenarios.Text:
You try ignore the burning sensation in your leg as you continue into the open area, leaving the alleyway behind you. The open area gives you vision of the school and it's underground safe bunker. 
You move towards it, the limp from your bleeding leg making it a slow progress.

Choices.ButtonText: Continue
